codeReview.summary: Reviewed the combined implementation of the Sites /reserve and /reserve/manage pages, the profile Upcoming reservations panel, the Book a table block, the operator Requests tab with approve/decline, the six-locale translations and the two carried-over App fixes against VAL-ONLINE-042..059 and VAL-CROSS-006..010 (later milestone commits 2c411941/5e7c5b12/661d65a5 amended some shared files; findings are confined to this feature's owned files). Residency holds: /reserve and /reserve/manage SSR render the shell only (apps/sites/src/pages/reserve/index.astro:1-100, manage.astro) with no guest data; the flag gate is fetched per request without edge caching (apps/sites/src/lib/org.ts:706-729 fetchAppJson(...,false)); apps/app/app/routes/resources+/sites.reservations.ts 404s unless the site is published and reservations.enabled+online are on, and returns only {online,waitlist,experiences,notifyMe}; manage tokens travel in the URL fragment, are copied to sessionStorage and stripped with history.replaceState (apps/sites/src/lib/reservations/fragment.ts:52-84) and in X-Reservation-Token (apps/sites/src/lib/reservations/api.ts:61-76,121); no reservations client module uses cookies or localStorage for tokens. The flow matches the public API contract (X-Client: web, Idempotency-Key on every mutation, server-clock-corrected hold countdown, 8-char confirmation code rendered dir=ltr, .ics, /manage/running-late alias, uniform 404/409/429 handling), the middleware marks /reserve* no-store (apps/sites/src/lib/site-headers.ts:91-110, apps/sites/src/middleware.ts:328-334), and the block is gated in the builder (addableBlockTypes, block-types.ts:287-297) and rendered from the published snapshot (RenderBlocks.astro:12,45-48). The Requests tab shows guest name/party/time/phone with channel badges and approve/decline wired to /operator/reservations/book/requests/:id/approve|decline (requests-panel.tsx, use-reservation-requests.ts, book-api.ts:2556-2578; tenant-api aliases operator-reservations-book.ts:1696-1711) with real Arabic strings in apps/app/app/locales/ar.po. Both carried-over fixes are implemented: the Date control and Jump to Today use the service-day business date (reservations+/_layout.tsx:130-153 useLiveNow with the active location's time zone and the reported dayStartMin, book-api.ts:1032-1033 resolveDayStartMin, business-date.ts:11-24) and the breadcrumb reservations segments are Lingui-wrapped (workspace-breadcrumb.tsx:72-83). All 190 reservations msgids have non-empty translations in ar/es/fr/de/zh and the Sites label-completeness test enforces it. The worker's own discovered issues are resolved in the combined code: public slots carry areaLabel (rsv-public-engine.ts:363-390) and the chips render it (flow.ts:374-391); the operator day feed/detail expose client (rsv-day-feed-service.ts:490, book-api.ts:889-891); settings.special-days.tsx:103 uses serviceDayBusinessDate; and the reserved-slug CMS fallback question is moot because VAL-ONLINE-043 accepts a 404. VAL-CROSS-006's guest clause holds: the manage view masks contact and carries no table ids or auto_reassigned events (rsv-public-booking-service.ts:158-225, reservations-public.ts:739-744). The findings below are non-blocking and confined to the preferred-time alternatives path and the block deep link.

issues.description: The availability search never passes `localMin` even when the guest arrived with `?time=` (preferredMin is parsed at flow.ts:153 and passed to the notify-me form at flow.ts:430, but not to `api.availability`, which accepts it at api.ts:140-150). The server only computes preferred-time alternatives when the request carries localMin and the requested time is missing (rsv-public-service.ts:210-213); without it, a fully booked day falls back to `localMin: preferred ?? slots[0]?.slotMin ?? 0` (rsv-public-service.ts:221), so `otherDateAlternatives` (rsv-public-engine.ts:451-459) shows each other date's earliest slot instead of a time near the requested one. Concrete path: the Book a table bar deep-links /reserve?location&party&date&time (block-bar.ts:96-102); when the requested day is exhausted, the guest sees other dates at the earliest time rather than near the requested time. The guest can still book (same-day times remain as chips), so no assertion is broken, but the requested-time context is lost. A fix would pass `localMin: preferredMin ?? undefined` to `api.availability` in flow.ts search(), matching the notify-me form.

`alternatives.sameDay` can never be shown by the flow: renderResults renders the alternatives block only after the `result.slots.length === 0` early return (flow.ts:483-523), while the API derives sameDay from the same `result.slots` list (rsv-public-service.ts:209-225), so sameDay is non-empty only when slots exist, and the client never displays it then. In the empty-slot state the flow shows the reason plus `otherDates` (which works: status 'full' computes alternatives without localMin) — same-day alternatives are presented as the chip list instead. If a validator reads VAL-ONLINE-046 as requiring a same-day alternatives presentation in the no-availability state, this branch ordering is why it cannot appear; functionally the day's remaining times are still visible as chips. A fix would either render sameDay alternatives alongside the chips when the requested time is unavailable or drop the unreachable sameDay branch and rely on the chips list.

VAL-ONLINE-054 says activating the block lands on /reserve with location, party, date and time prefilled from the `?location=&party=&date=&time=` query. The button layout's href carries only `location` and `party` (ReservationBlock.astro:34-40); date/time are added only by the inline bar (block-bar.ts:96-102). The block's inspector has no date/time fields (block-types.ts:240-247), so there is nothing configured to prefill for the button — the flow still lands on slot selection because /reserve defaults the date to today in the location's time zone and runs the search on load (flow.ts:151-153, 355-357). A validator checking only the button path will not see date/time in the URL; the inline path covers the four-parameter case. No code change is required unless the contract intends the button link to carry date/time, in which case optional default date/time inspector fields would need to be added and included in the href.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Changing Organization.siteLocales (or other org fields the App site snapshot caches) by SQL needs a KV purge: the App caches the published-org payload in KV for 24h (apps/app/app/utils/sites/kv-cache.server.ts:75), and only publishing from the UI invalidates it. The worker had to find and purge the local KV keys to enable the ar locale for riyadh-grill; the handoff reports it as a suggestion, but no library file mentions the KV cache or its purge (grep of library/*.md finds no KV reference). Validators who flip locales by SQL for VAL-ONLINE-055/056 will hit stale payloads.

summary: PASS. The combined implementation covers the feature's expectedBehavior and the VAL-ONLINE-042..059 / VAL-CROSS-006..010 requirements that belong to it: browser-direct guest booking with no guest data or tokens in Sites SSR, fragment-then-sessionStorage manage tokens, X-Client/Idempotency-Key/X-Reservation-Token contract adherence, server-clock-corrected hold countdown, confirmation with 8-char code + .ics + #t= manage link, manage view/modify/cancel/confirm/running-late/.ics, profile Upcoming reservations panel, the flag-gated Book a table block (builder + publish + Sites render), the operator Requests tab with approve/decline and channel badges, all six Sites locales translated (label-completeness test), and both carried-over App fixes (service-day business date for the Date control/Jump to Today; Lingui Arabic breadcrumbs). Residency, no-store, gate, and i18n checks hold. Three non-blocking findings: flow.ts never passes localMin so deep-linked preferred-time alternatives lose their requested-time context (other dates fall back to each date's earliest slot); the alternatives.sameDay presentation is unreachable in the flow (chips take precedence while the API only produces sameDay when slots exist); and the button-layout block deep link carries only location+party, not date/time, which is all the inspector configures. Five shared-state notes (KV purge needed after SQL siteLocales edits, stale user-testing.md entries now fixed by this commit, leftover seeded state, tenant-api nodes left running, and the unverified published-block render) are recorded for the validator to triage.
